text:
Rina: Quick flag 1 - my optkit refactor PR moved several quant profile pages and a few batching examples. Preview shows broken links in cookbooks and SDK snippets. PR #5189
Vik: Which files are failing in the preview?
Rina: Top ones reported:
- /optimize/quant_profiles/fast -> moved to /optkit/quant-profiles/fast.md
- /optimize/examples/batching/producer_consumer.md -> now /optkit/examples/batching/producer-consumer.md
- src/snippets/python/prefetch_demo.py -> imports old module path
Chen: For minimal disruption let's add a small YAML redirect map (docs/_data/legacy_map_optkit.yml) and a Sphinx post-build step that emits tiny HTML redirect pages for legacy paths. That buys time for snippet updates.
Vik: Agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to add the YAML and redirect generator. Chen, can you own updating the snippet imports?
Chen: Yes - I'll grep and replace redwood.optimize.* -> redwood.optkit.* and add a one-line MIGRATION comment to each updated snippet. PR by EOD.
Rina: Also: product docs link to an anchor /optimize/quant_profiles/fast#fp16. Can we preserve anchors?
Chen: Easiest is a client-side map anchors.json that maps legacy tokens to new fragment IDs and a small script to scroll to the new anchor when a legacy redirect page loads. Low friction.
Vik: I'll add the redirect pages and include the anchors.json lookup in the template. docs-bot: Staging preview posted: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/5189 (9 link errors) :eyes:
Rina: Plan:
- Vik: redirect generator + anchors.json + template hook (PR today)
- Chen: snippet import fixes + migration comments (PR today)
- Rina: follow-up with list of external repos to ping once redirects are live
Chen: One more nit: the batching example filenames were changed from snake_case to kebab-case. Some CI tests in downstream repos import the exact filenames. I'll include a small compatibility table in the YAML for both filename forms.
Vik: Good idea. We'll keep legacy pages for 14 days then schedule delete. Ping #integrations if any CI flakes after the template change.
Rina: Thanks all, drop any blockers here and I'll coordinate merges.
